paths.observation: Defaults, QoS upgrade, and version upgrade paths can save during initialization. Save synchronization is local to the JVM; the wrapper file lock is not acquired.
The API profile fetches authentication state from the messaging remote service and writes the configured authentication file before local initialization.
User-management saves write the configured authentication file. In T1, API and messaging refer to the shared PVC authority.
